def simulate(policy, exit_code, run_ticks=1, base=1, cap=16,
             burst=3, window=10, max_rounds=12):
    """返回 (重启时刻列表, 是否触发 start-limit-hit, 停止原因)。

    policy: no / always / unless-stopped / on-failure
    退避：第 n 次重启延迟 = min(base * 2**(n-1), cap)
    熔断：window 个逻辑秒内重启次数达到 burst 即判 start-limit-hit
    """
    t = 0
    log = []
    for n in range(max_rounds):
        t += run_ticks                       # 进程运行一段时间后退出
        if policy == "no":
            return log, False, "policy=no：从不重启"
        if policy == "on-failure" and exit_code == 0:
            return log, False, "on-failure：退出码为 0，认为是正常退出，不重启"
        if policy == "unless-stopped":
            pass                              # 只要不是被手动 stop 就重启
        if policy == "always":
            pass                              # 退出码 0 也重启
        recent = [x for x in log if t - x < window]
        if len(recent) >= burst:
            return log, True, "start-limit-hit：%d 个逻辑秒内已重启 %d 次（burst=%d）" % (window, len(recent), burst)
        delay = min(base * (2 ** n), cap)
        t += delay
        log.append(t)
    return log, False, "达到模拟上限"


def show(title, **kw):
    log, limited, reason = simulate(**kw)
    print("=== %s ===" % title)
    print("  policy=%s exit_code=%d" % (kw.get("policy"), kw.get("exit_code")))
    print("  重启时刻序列: %s" % (log if log else "无"))
    print("  重启次数 = %d" % len(log))
    print("  触发 start-limit-hit: %s" % limited)
    print("  停止原因: %s" % reason)
    print()
    return len(log), limited


print("### restart 策略与退避：四种策略 + 熔断 ###")
print()
n1, l1 = show("用例1：no（退出码 1）", policy="no", exit_code=1)

print("always 在退出码 0 时仍重启: %s（预期 True）" % (n3 > 0))
